about: Every NALTP game the archive holds: seasons -> weeks -> games. A season's playoffs follow its weeks, one 'Playoffs: <round>' entry per round. score is in the order team_a, team_b; a game played in halves adds its halves (each under parts); an overtime is a part of its own, not added in, and decides winner when the halves are level (overtime_score). Every part with a tagpro.eu match was checked against tagpro.eu: score_check (the score), sides_check (the players on each side against the team rosters), and the start time. check is the game's result and problems lists anything that didn't agree. Built by games_json.py.
